name: ACLUE
description: ACLUE is an evaluation benchmark designed to assess large language models' abilities in comprehending ancient Chinese. It consists of 15 tasks covering phonetic, lexical, syntactic, semantic, inference, and knowledge skills, highlighting performance differences between modern and ancient Chinese.
reputation: A specialized benchmark for ancient Chinese understanding that is mainly used in academic evaluations of language models on historical Chinese text.
notes: Focuses on ancient Chinese language comprehension with 15 diverse tasks; includes a leaderboard.
